options.argent.mirror_recipe.tooltip: Whether mirrors can be crafted, and from what. Off also hides them from the creative inventory; existing mirrors stay. Applies after /reload or rejoining.
options.argent.mirror_screen.tooltip: Off makes mirrors props: right-clicking does nothing.
options.argent.reflections.tooltip: What mirrors reflect. Entities Only is faster: players, mobs and items over plain glass.
options.argent.scrying.tooltip: Whether sneaking and using an empty hand on your pet wearing Scrying armour lets you see and move through it.
options.argent.scrying_library_loot.tool: A Scrying book can rarely turn up in stronghold library chests, so Scrying is found even without wither zombies. Applies to chests opened after /reload or rejoining.
options.argent.silver.tooltip: Silver ore generates, and silver items appear in the creative inventory. Existing silver stays. Ore changes apply to newly generated chunks after rejoining.
options.argent.soul_lantern.tooltip: Where a soul lantern must be for soul particles to rise where monsters can spawn. Off also removes the iron and silver nugget recipe.
options.argent.title: Argent Settings
options.argent.wither_zombies.tooltip: Whether wither zombies spawn in the Nether. Applies after rejoining; existing ones stay.
